hypotheses.hypothesis: Large TG0 / low MAD concentrates MSE
hypotheses.confidence: High for distribution; unresolved for clipping causality
hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Targets reach 82.03; the worst 10% of training sessions contribute about 55.6% of loss. Both large relative numerators and small denominators are present.
hypotheses.counterevidence_or_limits: There are no zero MADs; floor dominance occurs in only 1.33% of refit origins. Batch-gradient linkage was not retained.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_check: Independently inspect the named retrospective price references if needed; retain current labels.

hypotheses.hypothesis: No comparative advantage on this seed/fold
hypotheses.supporting_evidence: ZERO has the lowest MSE. E5−TM0 mean IC is only +0.0038793.
hypotheses.counterevidence_or_limits: Ranks and MSE measure different objectives; five-name observations and within-day origins are dependent.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_check: Choose one separately approved unchanged-model replication.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Optimization instability after an early useful epoch
hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Late clipping and validation deterioration occur in all four trajectories. E5 retains warned refit epochs.
hypotheses.counterevidence_or_limits: Early selected TM0/MC0/MC1 states precede the worst late updates. Clipping can be protective; overshoot, tail noise and recurrent amplification are not separated.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_check: Add compact batch loss/session-hash/preclip-norm telemetry only to a later approved fit.

hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Validation deteriorates later and monthly contrasts reverse.
hypotheses.counterevidence_or_limits: Final-prefix training MSE exceeds inner-validation MSE, and populations, floors and modes differ. This is not a controlled overfitting gap; no second seed/fold exists.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_check: Review shifts, then consider a separately approved WF2 replication.

hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Small MC0/MC1 score spread warranted inspection.
hypotheses.counterevidence_or_limits: Scores are finite, nonconstant and tie-free; sampled hidden states vary. Gate weights vary without saturation and frozen scores replay.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_check: No rescue is justified by a collapse claim; preserve the checks.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Market/peer increments are absent or unstable
hypotheses.supporting_evidence: MC0 underperforms TM0 here; MC1 gains cancel; E5 trades a small IC increase against worse MSE.
hypotheses.counterevidence_or_limits: One seed/fold and different capacities cannot establish absence of useful information or causal peer transmission. Counterfactuals show computational use only.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_check: Replicate the primary TM0/MC0 comparison without changing loss, features or timing.

hypotheses.supporting_evidence: Representation and scale mismatch were considered.
hypotheses.counterevidence_or_limits: Raw-to-scaled endpoints, input prefixes and identities match; distributions are finite. That does not rule out optimization sensitivity to legitimate tails.
hypotheses.next_cheapest_check: Inspect the largest channel tails before proposing any separate scaling study.
